agent_labels.meaning: true = valid vehicle; false = official unused padded slot

coordinates.axes: x forward, y left, heading positive left; metres and radians
coordinates.world_embedding: CARLA world with Y and yaw reflected; not NuPlan georeferencing
coordinates.bev_index_direction: row increases with forward x; column increases with left y
coordinates.bev_quantization: official _coords_to_pixel astype(int32), followed by rot90(mask)[::-1]; no alternate rounding

trajectory.sampling: existing TemporalSampler with engineering source_dt_s=0.1, target_dt_s=0.5; continuity of all intermediate annotations required
trajectory.clock_evidence: inherited 10Hz engineering contract; collection timestamp certification remains unverified

bev_rules.road: OpenDRIVE driving/bidirectional surfaces; junction roads exposed as INTERSECTION
bev_rules.centerline: driving/bidirectional baselines as LANE/LANE_CONNECTOR; official thickness=2 pixels
bev_rules.static: current actors mapped by bev_actor_name to czone_sign/barrier/traffic_cone/generic_object
bev_rules.vehicle: validated current vehicle actors; ego excluded
bev_rules.pedestrian: current walker/pedestrian actors with walker.* type_id
bev_rules.non_targets: validated traffic lights and supported regulatory signs ignored by existing official mapping
bev_rules.overlap: official ascending class iteration 1..6; later class overwrites earlier class
bev_rules.box_projection: existing planar real center, doubled extents and relative yaw; unsupported tilt refused
bev_rules.guardrail: not added in original label rules
bev_rules.failure: existing geometry/mapping/alignment refusals retained; no buffer(0) or fake background fill
